name: DESTINI
recent: Destini 在 2026 年 11 月公布 2027 财年第一季度业绩，营收同比大跌 63% 并录得约 900 万令吉净亏损。公司同时面临仲裁裁决，需向 Damen 支付 1800 万令吉，并预计额外计提 414 万令吉拨备。此外，公司近期签署多项谅解备忘录，并宣布将于 12 月 1 日召开第 22 届常年股东大会。
notable: 公司于 2026 年 11 月 24 日发布 2027 财年第一季度业绩，营收同比下滑 63%，净亏损约 900 万令吉。
公司于 2026 年 11 月 13 日公告，因 Damen 仲裁案败诉需支付 1800 万令吉，并预计额外计提 414 万令吉拨备。
公司于 2026 年 11 月 24 日及近期多次签署谅解备忘录（MOU）。
risks: 公司因 Damen 仲裁案败诉需支付 1800 万令吉，并预计额外计提 414 万令吉拨备。
2027 财年第一季度营收同比大跌 63%，净亏损约 900 万令吉。
公司涉及重大诉讼（material litigation），相关公告于 2026 年 11 月 13 日及 16 日发布。
earnings: 2026 财年（截至 6 月 30 日）全年营收 6344.7 万令吉，净亏损 1227.8 万令吉，净利率 -19.4%；营收环比下降 24.2%，同比降 29.7%，净亏损环比扩大 455.3%，同比扩大 245.5%。

recent_en: Destini reported a 63% year-on-year plunge in revenue and a net loss of about RM9 million for 1Q27 in November 2026. The company also faces an arbitration award requiring it to pay RM18 million to Damen, with an additional RM4.14 million provision expected.
notable_en: The company released its 1Q27 results on 24 November 2026, with revenue down 63% year-on-year and a net loss of about RM9 million.
On 13 November 2026, the company announced it must pay RM18 million following an unfavourable arbitration award to Damen, and expects an additional RM4.14 million provision.
The company signed several memoranda of understanding (MOUs) on 24 November 2026 and in recent months.
risks_en: The company must pay RM18 million after losing the Damen arbitration, with an additional RM4.14 million provision expected.
1Q27 revenue plunged 63% year-on-year, with a net loss of about RM9 million.
The company is involved in material litigation, with announcements on 13 and 16 November 2026.
earnings_en: For FY2026 (ended 30 June), revenue was RM63.447 million with a net loss of RM12.278 million and a net margin of -19.4%; revenue fell 24.2% quarter-on-quarter and 29.7% year-on-year, while net loss widened 455.3% quarter-on-quarter and 245.5% year-on-year.
